children: Aldel Financial II entered into an amendment to its Investment Management Trust Agreement to extend its SPAC timeline. The amendment permits up to fifteen one-month extensions from the current Oct 23, 2026 deadline to as late as Jan 23, 2028, with a $50,000 deposit into the trust for each monthly extension. It also reduces the amount of trust interest available to cover liquidation and dissolution expenses from $100,000 to $25,000. The changes are intended to provide additional time and flexibility to complete a business combination.
: Amendment to Investment Management Trust Agreement
: Monthly extensions up to 15 times through Jan 23 2028
